mapper.sql: select l.request_id as requestId, u.username as username, l.model_code as modelCode, l.upstream_model as upstreamModel, coalesce(g.group_name, p.package_name) as packageName, m.multiplier as multiplier, l.status_code as statusCode, l.latency_ms as latencyMs, l.prompt_tokens as promptTokens, l.completion_tokens as completionTokens, l.total_tokens as totalTokens, l.cached_prompt_tokens as cachedPromptTokens, l.user_amount as userAmount, l.cost_amount as costAmount, l.success as success, l.created_at as createdAt from request_logs l left join users u on u.id = l.user_id left join user_model_packages p on p.id = l.user_package_id left join model_groups g on g.id = p.group_id left join models m on m.model_code = l.model_code and m.deleted = 0
